ash_hollow.label: Find a sheltered grazing camp
ash_hollow.talk: The descent is steep. Travelers look for grass and shelter near the hollow before moving on.

fort_boise.talk: Restock what you can carry. The road ahead still crosses dry stretches and mountains.

fort_hall.talk: Supplies are costly and finite. Westward travel enters dry Snake River country; hunting alone is an uncertain provision plan.

fort_kearny.talk: Construction at the new Platte post begins in June 1848. An early arrival should not expect a mature supply depot.

fort_laramie.talk: This is a trading post in 1848, before the United States Army acquires it in 1849. Check supplies before entering the uplands.

grande_ronde.label: Seek meadow grazing for the team
grande_ronde.talk: Meadows offer a welcome chance to rest the team before the next mountain road.

green_river.label: Check and repair crossing gear · 1 kit
green_river.talk: Pause to inspect the load and gear. Waiting can change water conditions; preparation does not make a dangerous crossing safe.

kansas_river.label: Check and repair crossing gear · 1 kit
kansas_river.talk: Inspect the load and crossing gear. Preparation reduces risk, but swift water remains dangerous.

laurel_hill.talk: The steep descent calls for caution. A loaded wagon presents a different problem from a party on foot.

snake_river.label: Check and repair crossing gear · 1 kit
snake_river.talk: Crossing this river is a serious decision. Check your gear and consider water conditions before committing.

soda_springs.label: Search for a better grazing camp
soda_springs.talk: The mineral springs are a landmark, not a promise that every nearby pool is suitable drinking water. Choose camp carefully.

south_pass.talk: The divide is broad, but exposed uplands and long distances between supplies still matter. Judge the team before proceeding.

context_rules.limits: Regional weights, trading schedules, stock and activity effects are authored game tuning, not reconstructed 1848 measurements. Dialogue is original paraphrase, not quotations.

forest.label: Blue Mountains and Cascades
forest.note: Wooded mountain roads and wet weather slow travel. Plan supplies before the descent.

highcountry.label: Rocky Mountain country
highcountry.note: Exposed uplands and colder weather strain working animals. Rest before the next long stretch.

plains.label: Platte grasslands
plains.note: River-bottom grass supports teams; late-season dry ground makes grazing harder.

sagebrush.label: Snake River country
sagebrush.note: Dry sage country offers uneven grazing. River water is not always accessible from the trail.

woodland.label: Missouri border country
woodland.note: Wooded streams and settled country give way to the open plains.

hunting: Baseline/adaptive: 65% center aim, stationary hunter, actual cover/reload/escape. Hunting study: 35/65/90% center aim, visible highest-meat target, lower-clearing movement when obstructed, 0.25s live ticks. Misses go to (0,0). Scripted skill assumptions, not measured player skill or pathfinding.
outfit: Current suggested cart for every profession; see outfitting_rules for exact quantities/prices/budgets.
policy: Bulk buy below 900 lb when affordable; passing-wagon buy below 90; hunt below 45 (adaptive: 90, hunting study: profile threshold); rest below 70 health or above 50 fatigue only with food. Adaptive holds $10 when buying food and sells supplies if blocked at toll. Hunting study watches worst individual health and provides care below 55 if an active condition and kit/cash available, at least 3 days apart; $10 cash reserve. Other batches no paid care. First affordable event choice; ferry or stage-appropriate crossing. Mixed/preservation profiles use two lb when well, three if any living traveler has a condition or internal health below 80. Preservation profiles process leftover fresh meat before buying/care; salt mode falls back to unsalted drying and attempts a salt purchase before hunting below five lb salt when cash >= $12. Spare-ox profile shoots one spare animal below90 food before buying food, then preserves using the same rules; retains one ox by policy (the game allows zero), never buys animals solely for food and never uses hand tools. Stop at 365 days/2400 actions or unresolvable choice.
